articles.title: T. Rex Footprints Show How Fast the Giant Walked
articles.summary: The first known adult T. rex trackway shows the giant ambling along at a brisk human walking pace.

articles.title: Four Volunteers Just Finished a Year of Pretend Life on Mars

articles.title: Blood Rain: The Sky Mystery With a Surprising Answer
articles.summary: Red rain has puzzled people for thousands of years. The answer is usually tiny algae spores or desert dust, not the sky itself.
